name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Explains why a view has no content or failed to load, and offers the action that changes that.

when: A list or view has nothing to show yet, no results, or failed to load (tone="danger").

guidance.rule: Never blame the user; say what will appear and how to get it.

builtIn: With announce, the message (title, description, details) is an alert; the actions stay outside it.
youProvide: A heading level when the state is the page's main content.
For a failed load, a retry Button that shows its pending state (see the example).

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: First use: what will appear here. No results: repeat the query. Cleared: the calm confirmation.

EmptyState.name: headingLevel
EmptyState.description: Renders the title as a heading where the state is the page's main content; a plain line by default.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: How the content gets here, or the fix; one or two sentences. Never blame the user.

EmptyState.name: primaryAction
EmptyState.description: The action that fills the view (`Button variant="primary"`), or "Clear filters" for no results.

EmptyState.name: tone
EmptyState.description: `danger` for a load that failed or a page that is not allowed: the icon in the danger tone.

EmptyState.name: details
EmptyState.description: Extra lines inside the message, under the description: an error code and when it happened, for support.

EmptyState.name: announce
EmptyState.description:
Announce the message (title, description, details) as an alert; the actions stay outside it. For a state that
replaces content the user was waiting for (a failed load); not for a first-use or no-results state.
